_meta.notes: Tier 1-4 active. Tier 5 identified but deferred — see ethical constraints in PHASES.md.

sources.name: WACOSS
sources.notes: Peak body for WA community services sector. Cost of living reports, policy submissions, sector news. RSS verified 2026-02-27.

sources.name: WALGA
sources.notes: Peak body for 139 WA local governments. Budget submissions, policy positions, local govt community services. No RSS feed available — manual submission from https://walga.asn.au/media-and-resources/latest-news

sources.name: Linkwest
sources.full_name: Linkwest — Neighbourhood and Community Resource Centres
sources.notes: Peak body for 140+ neighbourhood and community resource centres. Digital inclusion, grant opportunities, centre news. No RSS feed available — manual submission from https://linkwest.asn.au/Web/Web/News/Latest.aspx

sources.name: YACWA
sources.full_name: Youth Affairs Council of Western Australia
sources.notes: Peak non-government youth organisation in WA. Youth sector policy, awards, media releases, pre-budget submissions. RSS verified 2026-02-27.

sources.name: WAAMH
sources.notes: Peak body for community mental health in WA (200+ members). NDIS, mental health reform, conferences, training. No RSS feed available — manual submission from https://waamh.org.au/news-and-media

sources.name: ECCWA
sources.notes: Peak body for multicultural communities in WA. Settlement services, multicultural policy, community development.

sources.name: Shelter WA
sources.full_name: Shelter WA — Affordable Housing and Homelessness Peak Body
sources.notes: WA peak body for affordable housing and homelessness. Policy, research, housing crisis responses.

sources.name: Carers WA
sources.notes: Peak body for carers in WA. Carer support services, NDIS, aged care, policy updates.

sources.name: Financial Counselling Network WA
sources.notes: Financial counselling and inclusion services in WA. No confirmed RSS — manual email submission until RSS found via source discovery.

sources.name: City of Perth — Public Notices
sources.full_name: City of Perth Council — Public Notices
sources.notes: Council meetings, planning notices, community programs. Manual weekly check — no RSS available.

sources.name: City of Bayswater — Community News
sources.full_name: City of Bayswater — Community News and Notices
sources.notes: Local community news, grants, programs. Manual weekly check — no RSS confirmed.

sources.name: WA Government Announcements
sources.notes: Official WA government announcements affecting community sector. Manual weekly check.

sources.name: WA Government Media Statements
sources.notes: Ministerial media statements. Filter for Community Services, Housing, Health, Youth, Disability portfolios.

sources.name: PerthNow Local News
sources.notes: Curated community-relevant articles. Select only items directly relevant to NFPs, community services, or social issues.

sources.name: Reddit r/perth
sources.notes: RSS technically available but very noisy. Manual weekly review recommended — curate threads about charities, volunteering, NFPs, community needs. Copy relevant threads to email ingestion.

sources.name: LinkedIn WA Community Sector
sources.full_name: LinkedIn — WA Community Services sector leaders
sources.notes: No API available. Manual weekly review of posts from WACOSS, WALGA, Linkwest, YACWA, WAAMH LinkedIn pages. Forward relevant posts via email.

sources.name: Facebook Sector Pages
sources.full_name: Facebook — WA sector peak body pages
sources.notes: No API available. Pages to review: WACOSS, Linkwest, YACWA, WAAMH, Shelter WA. Forward announcements not covered by RSS feeds.

sources.name: Lotterywest Grants
sources.notes: WA's primary community grants body. New rounds, funded projects, guideline changes. Fortnightly check.

sources.name: WA Dept of Communities
sources.full_name: WA Department of Communities — Grants and Funding
sources.notes: State govt community sector funding rounds. Focus on new grant rounds, tender releases, policy changes affecting funded providers.

sources.name: Linkwest Grant Opportunities
sources.notes: Curated grant listings for community centres. Good early signal on new funding rounds before they appear elsewhere.

sources.name: CRC Community Papers
sources.notes: 40+ community newspapers published by Linkwest member centres. Weak tie source — forward highlights only, not full papers.
